feature_contract.goal: Preserve complete vehicle-selection sprites and their real colors by correctly decoding valid padded-row DDS data through the original fast texture replacement path, without white/missing selection textures or unrelated HUD changes.
feature_contract.scope_boundary: Only shared UI and vehicle-select DDS loader source row-stride handling, source bound checks, and its existing mutation verifier. Preserve original Direct3D9 native loader fallback, R84 stereo route, all good textures, SkyGlow, game input/FFB and DX11/DXVK isolation.
trace_stages: Original game and selected UI vehicle sprites load native/replacement DDS bytes through the intercepted D3DX file-in-memory Ex API.

Fast DDS decoding now derives the file source stride from DDSD_PITCH for a valid uncompressed single-mip texture, preflights all rows before allocating or locking D3D9 texture, and correctly interprets every pixel.

D3D9 destination LockRect receives independent device pitch; the unchanged sprite owner, R84 stereo submission, and OpenXR host then composite the uploaded car-selection atlas under original draw ownership.
subcomponents: Fix the source-level mismatch between declared DDS file row pitch and wrongly assumed tight-row source offsets, including exact source bounds/advance for one-mip opaque and alpha UI payloads.

Fail safely to existing native D3DX when source pitch is undersized, truncated, signed-invalid or an ambiguous padded multi-mip chain, and expand the existing fail-after static mutation suite while leaving destination pitch and texture replacement rollback intact.

diagnosis.original_evidence: At parent HEAD 24b7451, D3DXCreateTextureFromFileInMemoryEx_Custom checks only packed D3DXGetFormatSize bytes and uses srcRow = srcData + row*rowBytes unconditionally; this ignores DDSURFACEDESC2 lPitch when DDSD_PITCH declares padded file rows.
source_trace: Vehicle UI source bytes and optional DDS replacement enter the shared intercepted D3DX memory loader.
DDS_FILE header has DDSD_PITCH and lPitch; pre-existing code used only the calculated rowBytes and advanced by packed mipSize even when file stride was larger.
Fast-path texture upload fills managed IDirect3DTexture9 independent device LockRect rows, then the sprite and R84 stereo renderer consume uploaded texels.
diagnosis.root_cause: For noncompressed DDS with file row padding, the fast loader interpreted each source row from a tightly packed offset despite its own DDSD_PITCH metadata, causing subsequent rows to start inside preceding padding or pixel data.
alternatives_rejected: Do not alter the R84 geometry/stereo or force universal D3D9 row pitch; source and destination row pitches are independent.
Do not guess unknown alignment on padded multi-level DDS: keep the original native D3DX trampoline as the fail-closed decoder.
diagnosis.eye_ownership: Texture decoding precedes D3D9 sprite Draw and stereo per-eye composition; this change preserves producer semantic tags and eye ownership rather than remapping either eye.

runtime_evidence: All required GitHub exact-SHA build, analyzer, HUD DDS and package gates PASS. No Quest3/VDXR physical stereo, visual asset, reset, FPS or HMD acceptance run.
